items.title: Pay 'Aktualisierungsgebühr' (vehicle data update fee)
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 'zahlbar bis 30.11.2026'. 2026-11-30 is a Monday, not a weekend day or public holiday in NW, so no shift under §193 BGB applies. Due date as printed: 2026-11-30. However, this letter shows strong hallmarks of a scam (see warnings) and the obligation itself is almost certainly not legitimate.

warnings: This letter shows strong signs of being a scam: there is no official German authority called 'Zentralregister Fahrzeugdaten Deutschland'; vehicle registration data is held by the local Kfz-Zulassungsstelle, not by a private postbox service in Berlin.

The payment IBAN (LT98 7044 0001 1820 4477) is a personal account in Lithuania belonging to 'R. Kazlauskas', not an official German authority account — a major red flag for a fee supposedly owed to a German 'register'.
The letter uses pressure tactics ('Ohne Aktualisierung kann die Zulassung ab Januar 2027 ruhen', threat to report to the Zulassungsstelle if unpaid) typical of fraudulent demand letters.

Do not pay the requested 89,00 € or send any personal/vehicle data in response; instead verify directly with your local Kfz-Zulassungsstelle whether any update is actually required, and consider reporting this letter as fraud.
